positive_examples.text: I find the structured layout, editing tools, and Ask photos helpful. I also am liking the photo & video remix features.

Google is the best! They have kept all of my pictures for 10 + years. Gemini is also great. without details, I have saved important papers, and taught some important information so I don't erase it. great patient accurate 👍😀

Google brought back the perspective tool for cropping images so I'm bringing my review back up to 5 stars. Magic eraser tool works surprisingly well. Editing an image using prompts to Gemini has been really helpful in some cases, but it also horribly misses the mark other times. Looking forward to that functionality improving over time.
